title: Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy value is not a recognised token
description: The Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy value is none of `require-corp`, `credentialless` or `unsafe-none`. A browser discards a value it does not recognise and behaves as if the header were absent, so a deployment that believes it enabled cross-origin isolation is not isolated at all.
remediation: Set Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy to `require-corp` (or `credentialless` where that is the deliberate choice). Check the spelling against the specification rather than a framework default.
limitation: One header value. The rule validates the token and does not decide whether the page actually needs isolation or whether its subresources would satisfy require-corp.
